import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;

public class LoginApiTest {
    static void incomplete(String step) {
        System.out.println("INCOMPLETE: " + step);
        System.exit(3);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String url = System.getenv("PRACTICE_API_URL") + "login";
        String body = "{\"email\": \"priya@library.test\", \"password\": \"Pass@123\"}";
        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
                .uri(URI.create(url))
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body))
                .build();
        HttpResponse<String> response = HttpClient.newHttpClient().send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
        int status = response.statusCode();
        System.out.println(status == 200 ? "PASS: status is 200" : "FAIL: status is " + status + ", expected 200");
        boolean named = response.body().contains("\"name\":\"Priya\"") || response.body().contains("\"name\": \"Priya\"");
        System.out.println(named ? "PASS: name in the reply is Priya" : "FAIL: name in the reply is not Priya: " + response.body());
        if (status != 200 || !named) System.exit(1);
    }
}
